Here's the full breakdown for 8 May to 8 September:

Rent: AED 4,500/month x 3 months = AED 13,500
Security deposit: AED 1,000 (refundable within 14 working days after check-out)
Upfront to secure: AED 9,000 (first + last month)

VAT, water, electricity and internet are all included. Does that work for your budget, or do you have any questions before deciding?
